entry.title: New: BILL028(24) (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Amends provisions of the real property tax home exemption for disabled veterans, and their surviving spouses. Expands the eligibility for the real property tax exemption for totally disabled veterans to those who are at least 80 percent disabled, and their surviving spouses. Provides for a real property tax exemption in the amount of ___________ on all real property owned by blind and deaf persons, and veterans who are less than 80 percent disabled, as certified on forms prescribed by the City’s Director of Budget and Fiscal Services.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.4 which sets a two-year filing period on pending bills.
